q20.

**Server-Sent Events (SSE) over HTTP; `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (endpoint in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`); CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations, UpsertMemoReaction, DeleteMemoReaction**

Details:

**Mechanism** — plain SSE (`text/event-stream`), not WebSockets. The endpoint is `GET /api/v1/sse`, registered by `RegisterSSERoutes` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:125` on the same CORS-enabled gateway group as the rest of `/api/v1`. Auth is a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header (`sse_handler.go:34-44`); the handler sets `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no`, writes an initial `: connected` comment, and sends a `: heartbeat` comment every 30s (`sse_handler.go:17`, `:100-107`). The browser side is `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` — it uses `fetch` with `Accept: text/event-stream` (`:201-211`) rather than `EventSource` (so it can send the bearer header), and each event invalidates React Query keys.

**Hub** — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`: `SSEHub` holds a `map[*SSEClient]struct{}` under an `RWMutex`; `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Close`/`Broadcast`. Each client has a 32-event buffered channel and events are dropped rather than blocking a slow client (`sse_hub.go:112-129`). `canReceive` filters private memos to the creator or admins (`sse_hub.go:131+`). It's constructed in `v1.go:57` and closed at shutdown via `server/server.go:38,77,204`. Event types are `memo.created`, `memo.updated`, `memo.deleted`, `memo.comment.created`, `reaction.upserted`, `reaction.deleted` (`sse_hub.go:15-20`); helpers live in `sse_event_helpers.go`.

**Broadcasting handlers** (all `*APIV1Service`):
- `CreateMemo` — `memo_service.go:163`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:585`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:126`
- `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:513`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`) — these three broadcast indirectly through the shared helper `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, which calls `s.SSEHub.Broadcast` at `memo_update_helpers.go:71`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` — `reaction_service.go:106`
- `DeleteMemoReaction` — `reaction_service.go:161`
